Thank you for your patience as several major changes are being rolled out.
Large updates can sometimes introduce unexpected issues, but these changes are important for the long-term improvement and stability of MuniBridge.
The backend communication between MuniBridge and QuickBooks has been completely rebuilt. This refactor enables new features and performance improvements that were not practical before.
With these changes, QuickBooks will not let you close it unless MuniBridge is closed first.
QuickBooks Online is not affected yet by these changes
QuickBooks transactions now appear in the history window
QuickBooks requests (such as sending invoices) are much faster
QuickBooks requests can continue even while modal dialogs are open
Improved long-term reliability once this refactoring phase is complete
Because this was a large internal change, please let me know if you experience any of the following:
QuickBooks not closing properly after MuniBridge is closed
Any errors, including what you were doing when they occurred
These updates have been tested, but behavior can vary between machines. Your feedback is extremely helpful in identifying any remaining issues.
